result.summary: This PR replaces Bitcoin Core's hand-rolled strerror_s/strerror_r/FormatMessageA handling with std::system_category().message(err), which the author notes internally dispatches to the same platform functions but should also handle unknown errors more consistently. It collapses the separate Win32ErrorString function into SysErrorString, removes the now-unnecessary STRERROR_R_CHAR_P CMake introspection check, and drops the related lint exception. Total diff is small (+7/-67 across 8 files).
result.problem: The codebase previously carried three separate, platform-specific implementations of thread-safe error-string retrieval (POSIX strerror_r variants and Windows strerror_s/FormatMessageA), which is extra code to maintain and test across platforms. This affects contributors maintaining util/syserror and anyone building on non-mainstream platforms where the CMake check might behave unexpectedly.

result.card: This PR (fanquake) replaces Bitcoin Core's three separate hand-rolled strerror_s/strerror_r/FormatMessageA implementations with a single call to std::system_category().message(err), also collapsing Win32ErrorString into SysErrorString and dropping the now-unneeded STRERROR_R_CHAR_P CMake check. It is a maintenance and internal-consistency improvement in src/util, the shared error-string helper used across fs, sock, and other utility code; no bug report or crash motivated it but the author notes the new approach should better handle unknown error codes. Only one reviewer (maflcko) commented, with a minor wording nit that was promptly fixed, leaving no open objections. The PR is Ready for review with no dependency on other PRs. Impact is modest: P3 in utils for reducing a small recurring maintenance burden, P4 in build for a minor CMake simplification.
